text.autoconfig.appleskin.title: AppleSkin
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.showFoo: If true, shows the hunger and saturation values of food in its tooltip while holding SHIFT
Always show food values in tooltip
If true, shows the hunger and saturation values of food in its tooltip automatically (without needing to hold SHIFT)
Show hunger restored from held food
If true, shows the hunger (and saturation if showSaturationHudOverlay is true) that would be restored by food you are currently holding
Show overlays for food in off-hand
If true, enables the hunger/saturation/health overlays for food in your off-hand
If true, shows estimated health restored by food on the health bar
If true, shows your food exhaustion as a progress bar behind the hunger bar
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.showSat: If true, shows your current saturation level overlayed on the hunger bar
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.showFoo: Show food values in Debug Screen
If true, shows your hunger, saturation, and exhaustion level in Debug Screen
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.showVan: Animate HUD icons to match Minecraft
If true, health/hunger overlay will shake to match Minecraft's icon animations
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.maxHudO: Max alpha of flashing HUD icons
Alpha value of the flashing icons at their most visible point (1.0 = fully opaque, 0.0 = fully transparent)
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.hoverTo: If true, hovering a Totem of Undying in an inventory screen moves it to your offhand and/or hotbar
Move the totem to your offhand first (when the offhand has no totem)
Also move a totem to the chosen hotbar slot
Hotbar slot that hover totem fills
Delay between moves, in ticks (1 tick = 0.05 seconds)
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.fastXpE: If true, holding right click while holding an XP bottle throws bottles rapidly
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.fastXpD: Delay between throws, in ticks (0 = every tick, 1 tick = 0.05 seconds)
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorM: If true, holding right click on a respawn anchor automatically charges and detonates it
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorS: Delay before switching items, in ticks
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorG: Delay before placing glowstone, in ticks
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorE: Delay before exploding the anchor, in ticks
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorT: Hotbar slot switched to when detonating
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorS: Anchor Macro: swap back to anchor
After detonation, switch back to the respawn anchor in your hotbar
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.anchorP: After detonation, switch to an ender pearl and throw it
Aim the thrown pearl downward (only the throw packet)
Minimum seconds between pearl throws (0 = every time)
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.autoCry: Places and breaks crystals automatically while the activate button is held
Mouse button that runs it: 0 = left, 1 = right, 2 = middle
Chance of placing on a tick where it is possible
Chance of breaking on a tick where it is possible
Don't crystal while a dead player is nearby
Wait until a nearby player has just been hit
With Weakness, briefly switch to a sword to break the crystal
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.doubleA: Double Anchor
Holding an anchor and right clicking a charged anchor sends one extra interaction packet
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.macro19: Places obsidian + end crystal on the top face you look at and breaks crystals
Mouse button that runs it: 0 = left, 1 = right, 2 = middle
Chance of placing on a tick where it is possible
Chance of attacking a crystal on a tick where it is possible
Swing at air when no crystal is in range
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.autoHit: Auto Hit Crystal
Hold the button with a sword: places obsidian, switches to a crystal, then runs Auto Crystal
Auto Hit Crystal: button (0/1/2)
Mouse button that runs it: 0 = left, 1 = right, 2 = middle
Auto Hit Crystal: check place
Only start when obsidian can be placed on the block you look at
Auto Hit Crystal: switch delay (ticks)
Delay before switching items
Auto Hit Crystal: switch chance (%)
Chance of switching on a tick where it is possible
Auto Hit Crystal: place delay (ticks)
Delay between obsidian placements
Auto Hit Crystal: place chance (%)
Chance of placing obsidian on a tick where it is possible
Auto Hit Crystal: work with totem
Also start while holding a totem
Auto Hit Crystal: work with crystal
Also start while holding an end crystal
Auto Hit Crystal: sword swap
If you look at obsidian/bedrock when starting, skip placing obsidian
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.shieldB: Hitting a player who is blocking switches to an axe from the hotbar first
Auto Shield Breaker: require attack key
Only help hits made while you hold the attack button
Only help while a sword, axe or mace is in your main hand
Return to the previously held slot after the hit
text.autoconfig.appleskin.option.doubleA: Double Anchor: chance (%)
Chance of the extra packet firing
Double Anchor: glowstone cover
Cover the spent anchor with glowstone afterwards
Double Anchor: cover delay (ticks)
Delay before placing the cover glowstone
Double Anchor: hold repeat
Keep repeating the sequence while the macro key is held
Double Anchor: macro delay (ticks)
Delay between stages
Double Anchor: macro swap items
Switch items automatically for each stage
Double Anchor: macro swap back
Switch back to your original slot when done
Double Anchor: macro explode slot (1-9)
Hotbar slot switched to for the detonations
Double Anchor: damage tick
Delay the final explosion until a nearby player is mid damage-tick
Double Anchor: damage tick range (x0.1 blocks)
Range for the damage-tick check (60 = 6.0)
Double Anchor: damage tick max wait (ms)
Max time to wait for a damage tick
